mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate is held constant for two consecutive months above 4.5%, market expectations for future rate cuts diminish, lowering discount rates and boosting the present value of equity cash flows, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: FOMC holds or signals hold after a restrictive stance
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically higher than during similar non-hold periods (p > 0.05 in t-test), or FEDFUNDS does not remain above 4.5 for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp monthly increase in CPIAUCSL by more than 0.3% followed by a sustained decline in FEDFUNDS within the same quarter is interpreted as a shift toward price stability and rate easing, which elevates equity valuations and produces positive 60-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL increases >0.3% in a month and FEDFUNDS decreases in the following month
regime_hint: Transition from inflationary tightening to price-stability easing
failure_condition: No significant positive 60-day forward returns during such CPI-FEDFUNDS pairs (p > 0.05), or the CPI increase is not followed by FEDFUNDS decline.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly rise in PAYEMS exceeding 10,000 jobs for three consecutive months indicates strengthening labor market conditions, which boosts consumer confidence and corporate earnings expectations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases >10,000 for three consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day cumulative forward returns remain negative despite the labor signal, or the increase in PAYEMS is not sustained for three months.

mechanism_narrative: When HOUST rises by at least 5% in a single month, reflecting a surge in industrial production, it signals robust underlying demand for capital goods and consumer durables, which elevates earnings growth forecasts and produces positive 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
regime_hint: Economic expansion with rising industrial activity
failure_condition: No significant positive 20-day forward returns coincide with such HOUST spikes (p > 0.05), or the increase is not sustained.

mechanism_narrative: A consecutive monthly decline in INDPRO by at least 2% suggests weakening manufacturing capacity and rising supply-side pressures, which can trigger a term premium trade: investors discount future cash flows more aggressively, pushing down equity valuations and producing negative 60-day S&P 500 forward returns.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO decreases >2% for two consecutive months
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not statistically lower than during similar INDPRO declines (p > 0.05), or INDPRO does not decline for two months.

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE falls below 4% for three consecutive months, it signals a labor market cooling that reduces wage growth expectations and dampens equity earnings growth forecasts, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative during such UNRATE declines (p > 0.05), or the UNRATE decline is not sustained.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent monthly decline in RSAFS of at least 5% over two consecutive months, amid rising CPIAUCSL, indicates a balance sheet contraction and tighter financial conditions, which elevates risk premia and produces negative 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS decreases >5% in a month and CPIAUCSL increases in the same month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative during such pairs (p > 0.05), or the RSAFS decline is not persistent.

mechanism_narrative: During a regime of persistent CPIAUCSL inflation above 7% for four consecutive months, investors demand higher real yields, depressing equity valuations; this produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than during similar high-inflation periods (p > 0.05), or CPIAUCSL does not remain above 7% for four months.
